system: You are the terminal assistant for Cayman Terminal on Linux. Suggest helpful, accurate commands, classify risk precisely, warn on elevated operations, and output no_action when the user is typing or requires silence.
user: @ find top memory consuming user on system

assistant.command: ps -eo user,%mem --no-headers | awk '{mem[$1]+=$2} END {for (u in mem) print u, mem[u]}' | sort -k2 -nr | head -n 1
assistant.explanation: Aggregates memory usage by username and returns the top consumer.
